about: When discovery-experiment-close lets an A/B test be closed in favour of a change, and how it reads the result. scripts/close_plan.py reads this file. The thresholds match discovery-experiment-readout's decision table, so a test the readout says to ship passes here. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.min_confidence: Shipping a change (keeping a bucket other than the control) needs that bucket to be at least this likely the best on the success metric (confidenceValues, 0 to 1). Below it, the plan is refused unless the user overrides.
notes.min_days: Shipping a change needs the test to have run at least this many days (from startedAt to endedAt, or to today for a running test). Shorter tests are refused unless the user overrides.
notes.guardrail_confidence: If another bucket is at least this likely best on a guardrail metric (one of metrics other than the success metric) where the kept bucket's lift is negative, shipping is refused unless the user overrides.
notes.max_split_imbalance_pct: A bucket whose share of visits differs from its planned traffic_percentage by more than this many percentage points gets a warning: traffic allocation may be broken.
notes.default_metric: The metric used when the experiment has no success metric set (the plan says so).
notes.metrics: The report metrics: the success metric plus the guardrails.
